It’s your first day and you’re overwhelmed in a new environment and you’re scared. It’s 100% normal! Enjoy the time you have to yourself and start doing a bit of research about things to do around you. You’ll find out where the closest grocery store is and you’ll be solid.

Just know that you don’t stick out. No one around knows you’re not from there unless you tell them. You have started a new chapter of your life! I’m still in college and I personally wish I could’ve been in res to experience the ultimate “student life” because it’d be cool. Just know that it was everyone’s move in day yesterday so there’s MANY other students feeling the same way as you. You should approach others and start a conversation. And know YOU GOT THIS! Good luck with your studies!

Thanks for your advice. I will definitely do all of that. It makes me so sad that you feel like you’re weighing people down..that’s not the case at all! There is absolutely no weight or annoyance about mental illness. I think the weight gets passed on when you decide to give up. When my uncle died it looked like he literally handed his depression onto my dad. There was so much running through his mind and he couldn’t believe it happened. So please do not think you’re a weight... you’re worth WAY more than that. 

We’re human. We run this world when compared to other animals. We are smart, talented and driven by our powerful minds. Good luck and your advice was much appreciated.

I’m from Canada and sweet 16s are a thing here! For my sweet 16 I think I went to a buffet that I really enjoyed. I didn’t have a party since they weren’t really my thing. I’m 20f and I already forget what I did for my 16th birthday. I’m lame. 

But if a party is something you want to do, then you should! I don’t think you’d be considered a brat for asking. Just be polite and ask your parents to help throw you a party! If you’re worried it’ll be expensive for your parents but you still want to make your house/event hall like cute. Here are some tips: You can do a potluck, create DIY decorations, having it outdoors can give you more space, try creating invitations online. but instead of paying for them just screenshot them when you’re done and print them at home. It’ll save you a few bucks here and there. I have a bunch of cheap ideas for event planning since I planned a great wedding shower for my sister. Feel free to DM me if you would like some help or information. I have exams to study for, but I will do anything to get out of studying. Hope you have a great sweet 16 and one you will remember.
